provenance.paper_title: Dynam3D: Dynamic Layered 3D Tokens Empower VLM for Vision-and-Language Navigation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Projects 2D features into 3D space.; Merges 2D instance masks into geometry-consistent 3D instances.; Aggregates instance information into zone-level tokens.; Updates feature points with frustum culling to refresh outdated views.. graph query/traversal over the memory conditioned on the current goal.
During operation, Dynam3D applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Patch-level 3D feature points; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, Dynam3D applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to Patch-level 3D feature points; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, Dynam3D applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to Patch-level 3D feature points; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (Patch-level 3D feature points) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
